gate: Continue from seed 0 to seed 1 only if final four-pass accuracy strictly exceeds zero-pass, one-pass and matched reset-state control. A positive screen is not confirmation.
initial_checkpoints: Original paired default-trained 68M B0; backbone fully frozen
change: Raw contextualized hypothesis-token mean replaces native classifier features as the problem anchor. Native logits and all refiner parameter counts are preserved. BF16 caches store projection inputs at their actual AMP consumption precision, checked for exact cached/live equality.
costs: Include original source training, token encoding and head training. Report tensor-cache storage and cache-inclusive GPU peak.
interpretation: Exploratory conditioning fix after whole-input anchors failed. No test/private reserve scoring; keep architecture fixed throughout this study.
